documents.summary: Landing page of University Information Services guidelines with six principles (accountability, transparency, fairness, privacy, security, IP) and two warnings about bots and unapproved tools. It sets conditions on AI use, not a teaching rule.
documents.stance_why: The page is a university-wide set of principles. The guidelines never hand the decision to instructors or courses; they attach conditions to AI use (accountability, disclosure where required, privacy, IP, approved tools), so permit with conditions.
